reel.meanBig: = you’re literally “walking on my cookie”
reel.tail: …and yes, we take our cookies personally. 😄

caption:
In Germany, we don't say 'you're getting on my nerves' — we say 'du gehst mir auf den Keks' (you're walking on my cookie 🍪). And yes, we take our cookies personally. 😄
